metadata.description: Claude skills by mkarami313: debugging large .NET + React apps, long-running tasks, context compaction, skill recording, framework upgrades and the Iranian dev stack.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: Token-efficient bug hunting in large .NET + React web apps (200k+ lines, modular monolith, multi-tenant): triage scripts, a bug ledger, evidence-first fix loop, flaky-test bisection, review gate and root-cause checklists.

plugins.name: task-observer
plugins.description: Watch long-running tasks without burning context — run/wait/status for builds, tests, jobs and deploys with stall and repeated-error detection — plus a loop-guard hook that catches agents going in circles.

plugins.name: record-skill
plugins.description: Record a workflow like a macro and turn the Claude Code session transcript (steps that worked, fixes, user corrections) into a tested, reusable SKILL.md.

plugins.name: compaction-guard
plugins.description: Keep goals, user instructions, decisions and next steps across Claude Code context compaction: a NOW.md state file plus PreCompact snapshot and SessionStart re-injection hooks.

plugins.name: framework-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrade frameworks and runtimes safely (React, Next.js, Angular, .NET, Django, Rails…): official guides instead of memory, baseline, codemods, one green commit per step, no silenced errors, version detection script.

plugins.name: iran-payments
plugins.description: Iranian payment gateways (ZarinPal, Zibal and any PSP): safe request → callback → verify flow, Rial/Toman, idempotent verify, reconcile job, review checklist and a C#/.NET reference.

plugins.name: persian-rtl
plugins.description: Persian RTL web UIs: logical CSS/Tailwind, icon mirroring, bidi, ی/ک and digit normalization, ZWNJ, Jalali dates and Tehran time, fonts and licenses, plus an RTL lint script.
